root_idea.summary: The root centers on the small, tender young one and the qualities associated with that state.
root_idea.development: From the young one's tenderness and the care given to young-bearing animals, the lexical field extends to softness, early or late transitional times, childhood, and several derived natural and social descriptions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular dictionary citation form طِفْلٌ.

senses.definition: A young human child, especially one in the tender stage of infancy and childhood.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, the form appears both as a singular referring to the child stage and in collective or plural expressions for children. The child stage is described in relation to early development, lack of awareness of sexual privacy, and the transition to puberty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become soft or tender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to things generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter the time called طَفَل.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional temporal use; the cited lexical discussion reports contrasting applications of the time-name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun rose.
The sun reddened at setting, inclined toward setting, or approached its setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal description of the sun near the end of its course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To graze vegetation so as to raise dust over it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional transitive construction describing grazing that soils or dusts the vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For herbage to become soiled with dust and thereby marred or injured.
For a mother camel to urge her young one onward by rubbing or pushing it, going before it and waiting until it catches up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing the care and encouragement of a young animal during movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the night to begin to grow dark or draw near.
To treat camels gently during travel so that their young can catch up with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction concerns a group of camels accompanied by their young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consider the consequences of speech, reflect on it, or seek to understand its results.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative or extended usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a female to have a young one or to give birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a female human, wild animal, camel, or other animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To intrude uninvited at a feast or impose oneself on someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feast-intrusion usage is reported as established in the speech of the people of Iraq.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft or tender; also, of a female person, soft or tender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form is طَفْلَةٌ; the adjective may be applied to things as well as to a woman or young woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A yellowish or whitish earth used for scouring or dyeing cloth, also called fuller’s earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional material term associated particularly with Egypt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young one or youngling, especially of a beast or wild animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical application of the noun beyond its Quranic human-child occurrences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part or portion of something, including a small or abstract portion such as a share of anxiety or love.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended usage; expressions include طِفْلُ الهَمِّ and طِفْلُ الحُبِّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A falling spark, live coal, or fire just struck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended material use; the plural is أَطْفَالٌ in the cited expression for scattered sparks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended usage attested in poetic citation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An object of want, especially a small object of want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended usage, as in the expression أَطْفَالُ الحَوَائِجِ for small wants or needs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Night, or the first part of night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended temporal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun when it is near setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended temporal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period at the margin of the day: the time after sunrise before full daylight, or the late afternoon and dusk; also the onset or darkness of night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical reports give contrasting applications at the beginning and end of the day, with related use for the arrival of night and darkness itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain, especially a shower of rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for rain associated with the Pleiades or for falling showers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wind that blows gently or softly.
Herbage that does not become tall.
Dry clay.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal term of Yemen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Turbid water remaining in a watering-trough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form طِفْئِلَةٌ may denote a portion of it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state or condition of being a child: early infancy or, more broadly, childhood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Related abstract nouns include طُفُولَةٌ and طَفَالَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who intrudes at feasts uninvited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is connected with the traditional personal name طُفَيْل, associated with this behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who sells fuller’s earth.
More or most intrusive and uninvited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective associated with the feast-intruder sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female having a young one, especially one that has recently given birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to human females, wild animals, camels, or other females; plural forms include مَطَافِلُ and مَطَافِيلُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clouds followed by smaller clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed poetic or dialectal application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A night whose cold kills young animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional descriptive phrase.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Night onset is covered by the broader temporal entry.
Darkness itself is covered by the broader temporal entry.
The gentle-wind construction is covered by the same entry.
Editorial correction identifying the cited form as an apparent mistake.

cautions: Classical authorities vary on the age boundary of طِفْلٌ, describing it either as the stage before discernment or as extending from birth until puberty; the Quranic contexts reflect the broader child stage and explicitly contrast children with puberty in 24:59.
